footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 10.9% to $16.9B in 2025. Gross margin was 53.3%, versus 53.5% a year earlier, and operating income rose 9.9% to $2.9B, a 17.3% margin.
Net income rose 11.2% to $2.0B, or $5.64 per share. Operating cash flow was $4.8B and free cash flow $4.0B, versus $3.1B; Con Edison returned $1.2B through dividends.
sources: Consolidated Edison, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
